node.statement: Lemma 5.1 (Helper): d[n]*(d+n)^{up k} * integral |u><u|^{n+k} du = (e+X_{n+k})...(e+X_{n+1}) (Pi_sym^n tensor I^{tensor k}). Proof: Apply Proposition 2.3 with m=n to get Pi_sym^{n+k} = ((e+X_{n+k})/(n+k))...((e+X_{n+1})/(n+1))(Pi_sym^n tensor I^k). Then use Pi_sym^{n+k} = d[n+k] integral |u><u|^{n+k} du and d[n+k]/d[n] = (d+n)^{up k}/((n+1)...(n+k)).
